text: {"question":"What technique is used to recover the total flux for saturated 2MASS stars, and what is the weighted‑mean value of the Hubble constant reported in the DES analysis?","reference_answer":"The total flux for saturated 2MASS stars is recovered by fitting a profile to the unsaturated scattered‑light wings of the stellar image and extrapolating that fit to the core. The weighted‑mean Hubble constant from the DES offset analysis is 73.267 ± 0.828 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹."}
